+Default ``FILE_UPLOAD_PERMISSION`` is now set
+---------------------------------------------
+
+:setting:`FILE_UPLOAD_PERMISSIONS` now defaults to ``0o644`` instead of
+``None``. Uploaded files that used to get permissions of ``0o600`` when
+using :class:`~django.core.files.uploadedfile.TemporaryUploadedFile` and
+permissions based on the current system's umask setting when using
+:class:`~django.core.files.uploadedfile.InMemoryUploadedFile` now
+consistently get permissions of ``0o644``, unless
+:setting:`FILE_UPLOAD_PERMISSIONS` is overridden.
+
+If you rely on the previous inconsistent behavior, you can set
+:setting:`FILE_UPLOAD_PERMISSIONS` to ``None``.
+
 Removed private Python 2 compatibility APIs
